fixture_set: sgp4 reference vectors and an OMM JSON sample
also_in: PyPI sdist sgp4-2.27.tar.gz, SHA-256 06d37247c6985739b707b8b39b6b83e06e8af783b2531e31965501ba983985f9 (SGP4-VER.TLE and tcppver.out were compared byte for byte with the repository files)
why: SGP4-VER.TLE + tcppver.out are the verification set of Vallado, Crawford, Hujsak and Kelso (Revisiting Spacetrack Report #3, AIAA 2006-6753): 33 satellites, 700 reference lines, produced by the official C++ code. sample_omm.json is a one-record sample (VANGUARD 1, epoch 2025-02-14) in CelesTrak's GP/OMM JSON field layout, shipped by python-sgp4 (its README points to CelesTrak for the format; that the record was downloaded from CelesTrak is likely but is not stated upstream).
notes: Five TLE lines in SGP4-VER.TLE (satellites 33333, 33334, 33335) have checksums that do not verify; this is how the file is published and is kept as is.
Line 2 of every satellite carries three extra fields after column 69 (start, stop, step in minutes from epoch) that are not part of a TLE.
